title: Lights — Cabin Floor Marking — Installation of the Photoluminescent Escape Path Strip
abstract: Replacement of the powered floor proximity marking by a bonded photoluminescent strip, a customer option that removes the emergency electrical load and the periodic functional test but adds a charge time restriction.

sections.planning_reason: Several operators asked for a floor proximity escape path marking that does not depend on the emergency power system, mainly to remove the periodic functional test and the battery maintenance. Photoluminescent strip was an accepted means of compliance and had been shown to work on other types. Charging performance under the ceiling wash luminaires fitted to this aircraft had to be demonstrated separately, which is why this Service Bulletin was issued later than the equivalent on other programmes.
sections.description: Photoluminescent strip is bonded along the seat track cover line on both aisles and around each exit, with a marker at every seat row. The lining panel is replaced by a version with a recessed channel that protects the strip edge, and tubular spacers lift the panel so that the channel clears the seat track. The powered floor marking and its wiring are removed and the emergency lighting controller is set to the option that inhibits the floor channel.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Remove the cabin seats along both aisles and lift the aisle carpet in zones 291 and 241. De-energise the emergency lighting system and discharge the batteries to the procedure in the maintenance documentation. Remove the powered floor marking and its wiring, and cap the harness at the seat track junction. Clean the seat track cover line to the surface preparation given in the accomplishment instructions. Bond the photoluminescent strip, working from the forward exit aft, and hold it under pressure for the stated cure time. Install the replacement lining panel D3320007009192 with tubular spacers AES27771-7A. Fit the additional strip segment at each exit panel 841LP7. Set the emergency lighting controller option and do the emergency lighting functional test. Install the charge time placard at each cabin attendant station. Refit the carpet and the seats and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to MRD-42K1 and MRD-46K1 aircraft from MSN M00001 through M00266. There is no pre-modification or post-modification condition: any aircraft in the range that still carries the powered floor marking may take this Service Bulletin.
sections.material_note: Kit K3320-1047-01 contains the strip, the lining panels, the spacers and the placards for one aircraft in a twin-aisle layout. Lead time is twenty-two weeks; the photoluminescent strip is the long-lead item and is made to order in the length of the layout.

type_data.compliance_time: At the operator's convenience, during a scheduled cabin visit.

title: Lights — Cabin Floor Marking — Installation of the Photoluminescent Escape Path Strip

issue.reason: Bulletin closed to new accomplishment in a published per-aircraft order, after the affected operators were notified, so that only one compliance route is live on any aircraft.

abstract: Closed to new accomplishment. This Service Bulletin installed the bonded photoluminescent escape path strip; it is closed aircraft by aircraft as the diode standard is embodied, so that no aircraft carries two live compliance routes for the same requirement.

sections.effectivity_note: Was applicable to MRD-42K1 and MRD-46K1 aircraft from MSN M00001 through M00266. Eleven aircraft remained open against this Service Bulletin when the diode standard was extended over the same population. Leaving both live would have offered two different compliance routes for one requirement on the same aircraft, so this Service Bulletin is closed per aircraft on the date the diode bulletin is recorded as embodied on that aircraft. The closing order, aircraft by aircraft, is in the accomplishment instructions. Until an aircraft reaches its closing date this Service Bulletin remains the applicable route for it and may be completed if it is already open.
sections.material_note: Kit K3320-1047-01 is withdrawn from the catalogue except against the eleven aircraft named in the closing order, for which kits remain available until their closing date. Aircraft carrying this standard are supported for spares until 2028; after that the light-emitting diode standard is the only forward path.

type_data.compliance_time: Closed to new accomplishment. On an aircraft named in the closing order, before that aircraft's closing date; on every other aircraft, not to be started.

revision_history.reason: Closed to new accomplishment with a per-aircraft closing order
